description: Both plots share the same axes; the x-axis is labeled "Steps", is linear, ranges from 0 to 500, and has tick labels at intervals of 100, while the y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards", is linear, and ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 for the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 for the bottom plot, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1 and 0.2, respectively. The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set", illustrates the training rewards of two models, Llama-On-Policy-Easy and Llama-LUFFY-Easy, across 500 steps. Llama-On-Policy-Easy is represented by a solid blue line, starting at approximately 0.05 and rising to around 0.3 by step 100, then fluctuating between 0.25 and 0.35 until step 500. Llama-LUFFY-Easy is depicted by a solid red line, beginning at 0.0, increasing to about 0.25 by step 100, and then stabilizing between 0.3 and 0.4 from step 200 onwards. The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set", compares the training rewards of Llama-On-Policy-Hard and Llama-LUFFY-Hard. Llama-On-Policy-Hard is shown as a solid blue line, starting at 0.0, peaking at approximately 0.025 around step 50, and then declining to nearly 0.0 by step 200, remaining there until step 500. Llama-LUFFY-Hard is represented by a solid red line, beginning at 0.0, rising to around 0.1 by step 100, and then gradually increasing to approximately 0.2 by step 500, with minor fluctuations.
